title: Beyond the 956: Susan Saint James, 'McMillan & Wife' and 'Kate & Allie' star, dies at 80
excerpt: Susan Saint James, the Emmy-winning actress known for 'McMillan & Wife' and 'Kate & Allie,' has died at 80. Her representative confirmed to PEOPLE she died Monday, October 26, 2026, after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Susan Saint James, the Emmy-winning actress beloved for her starring roles on the hit television series McMillan & Wife and Kate & Allie, has died at 80.

A representative for Saint James confirmed to PEOPLE that she died on Monday, October 26, 2026, after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

Born Susan Jane Miller in Los Angeles in 1946 and raised in Rockford, Illinois, Saint James headed to Hollywood at 20 and signed with Universal. She broke through on the television series The Name of the Game in 1968, earning three Emmy nominations and winning once.

In 1971 she joined McMillan & Wife opposite Rock Hudson, playing Sally McMillan for five seasons and earning three more Emmy nominations. She later starred in the films Outlaw Blues (1977) and Love at First Bite (1979).

In 1984 she began starring alongside Jane Curtin on the sitcom Kate & Allie, playing two divorced best friends raising their children together under one roof. The series ran until 1989 and brought her two more Emmy nominations.

She stepped back from Hollywood at the end of the 1980s, later appearing on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit and Suits, and received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2008. Away from the screen, she was a longtime champion of the Special Olympics, serving on its international board for decades.

Her family remembered her as someone who was generous with her time and energy, who never met a stranger, and who, even in the deepest grief after losing her youngest son, Teddy, in a 2004 plane crash, put everyone else first.

She is survived by her husband, Dick Ebersol, her four children, seven grandchildren, her sister, and her beloved service dog, Lola.

Sources: PEOPLE (representative and family statement); TheWrap.
